changelog.description: Evidence-backed source repairs from the Phase 4 audit: 8 ground-truth URLs replaced with verified canonical official URLs; 1 official alternative added; 1 query flagged for manual review (not yet resolved). All decisions were derived from cross-run retrieval evidence + provider probes (search/scrape) and are recorded per-query under the 'audit' key. No source was hardcoded into production code; this is benchmark data repair only.

Finalized repaired benchmark. Removed q057 (PGVCL): the only manual-review flag from the source audit -- official domain pgvcl.com is unreachable for direct HTTP and crawlers, never retrieved by providers, and no verified official alternative surfaced in Firecrawl/Tavily search. Question removed rather than kept with an unverifiable source. Reason recorded here and in audit_report_2026-08-30.md for auditability.
